summary.what_it_is: An LLM-powered system that automatically analyzes stocks from multiple markets (A-shares, Hong Kong, US, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, ETFs) daily and sends decision dashboards with scores, trends, buy/sell points, and risk alerts to channels like WeChat, Feishu, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and email.
summary.why_trending: The project offers free, zero-server deployment via GitHub Actions, supports many AI model providers and data sources, and has been featured on HelloGitHub and Trendshift, driving a large weekly star increase.
summary.who_its_for: Individual investors and developers who want automated AI-driven stock analysis reports delivered to their preferred messaging apps.
